description: Structural foundation: change the elf/macho/wasm dump stubs from (r,w) to (d: *const DumpContext), update the three call sites, emit element-gated file-type banners (replacing the TODO strings), and add all new Options fields + arg-loop handling + usage text + --all-headers extension (design §3, §5). Leaves the file buildable with banners-only bodies; FEAT-002..005 fill the real logic. This feature is a prerequisite for all others.
steps: In fn dump(d: *const DumpContext) change the three call sites: `return elf.dump(r, d.w);` (L209) -> `return elf.dump(d);`; `return macho.dump(r, d.w);` (L213) -> `return macho.dump(d);`; `return wasm.dump(r, d.w);` (L219) -> `return wasm.dump(d);`.

Rewrite each stub signature to `fn dump(d: *const DumpContext) !void` and body to: derive `const r = &d.fr.interface;` and (for now) print ONLY an element-gated file-type banner then return. ELF banner via `if (d.element(.@"file-type")) { try d.w.print("{s}: ELF {s} {s}\n", .{ basename, classStr, typeWord }); if (d.element(.newlines)) try d.w.writeByte('\n'); }` using std.fs.path.basename(d.opts.input_path); Mach-O and Wasm analogous ('<name>: Mach-O 64-bit ...', '<name>: WebAssembly ...'). This is the minimal buildable checkpoint.

Add to the Options struct (L11), all defaulting false in the final assignment: `program_headers: bool`, `dynamic: bool`, `dynamic_relocs: bool`, `dynamic_symbols: bool`, `summary: bool`, `disassemble: bool`, `disassemble_all: bool`, `disassemble_symbol: ?[]const u8`.

Add matching `opt_*` locals before the arg loop and wire them into the final `const opts: Options = .{ ... }` assignment (mirroring existing `opt_relocs orelse false` style; disassemble_symbol defaults to null).

In the `if (mem.startsWith(u8, arg, "-"))` chain, BEFORE the final `else fatal`, add branches: `--program-headers`/`--segments` -> opt_program_headers=true; `--dynamic` -> opt_dynamic=true; `--dynamic-symbols` -> opt_dynamic_symbols=true; `--dynamic-relocs` -> opt_dynamic_relocs=true; `--summary` -> opt_summary=true; `--disassemble=<sym>` (via mem.startsWith(u8, arg, "--disassemble="), arena-dupe the suffix) placed BEFORE the bare `-d`/`--disassemble` test so the prefix wins -> opt_disassemble=true + opt_disassemble_symbol=<sym>; `-d`/`--disassemble` -> opt_disassemble=true; `--disassemble-all` -> opt_disassemble=true + opt_disassemble_all=true.
Extend the existing `--all-headers` block (L80) to ALSO set opt_program_headers=true and opt_dynamic=true (additive; COFF ignores the new booleans).

Add a documented usage line (matching the existing block's formatting) for every new flag in the `const usage` string (L1748), including an honesty note that `-d` supports sBPF only; other machines print a clear 'disassembly not implemented for <machine>' message.
acceptance_criteria: `sig test lib/compiler/objdump.sig` compiles clean under strict .sig mode (no allocator or type errors).
`sig objdump --help` output lists every new flag.
Running `sig objdump --file-headers <any-elf>` prints the ELF file-type banner (no 'TODO dump elf file' text remains anywhere in the file).
The COFF arm and all coff.* functions are unchanged (byte-identical COFF output).
verification: grep confirm no 'TODO dump' strings remain (sanity only, not the gate)
findings:
DONE. All edits in lib/compiler/objdump.sig (worktree copy only; COFF arm untouched). `sig test lib/compiler/objdump.sig` compiles clean, 0 tests. `sig objdump --help` lists every new flag (verified by running the installed sig.exe with env SIG_LIB_DIR set to the worktree lib dir, because `sig objdump` loads objdump.sig from the compiler's lib dir, not CWD; `sig test <path>` reads the worktree file directly). No 'TODO dump' strings remain.

LINE RANGES (current file state after edits):
- Options struct: new fields at L31-40, grouped as `// Elf-specific` (program_headers L31, dynamic L33, dynamic_relocs L34, dynamic_symbols, summary) and `// Disassembly` (disassemble L39, disassemble_all L40, disassemble_symbol L40 `?[]const u8`). Order appended AFTER existing `tls`, BEFORE the `// Coff-specific` linker_member.
- opt_* locals: L83-90 (opt_program_headers, opt_dynamic, opt_dynamic_relocs, opt_dynamic_symbols, opt_summary, opt_disassemble, opt_disassemble_all, opt_disassemble_symbol:?[]const u8=null).
- --all-headers extension: L106,L108 add opt_program_headers=true; opt_dynamic=true.
- New arg branches: L173-190, inserted after the `--tls` branch and BEFORE the final `else fatal`. Order: --program-headers/--segments, --dynamic, --dynamic-symbols, --dynamic-relocs, --summary, --disassemble-all, then `startsWith --disassemble=` (arena-dupes suffix) placed BEFORE bare `-d`/`--disassemble`.
- opts assignment: new fields at L218-225.
- Dispatcher call sites updated to elf.dump(d)/macho.dump(d)/wasm.dump(d) (~L? in the dump fn starting L253).
- Stubs rewritten: elf.dump at L337 (reads std.elf.Header.read(r); classStr 64/32; typeWord REL->relocatable/DYN->shared object/EXEC->executable/CORE->core/else->unknown; banner `{s}: ELF {s} {s}` gated by .@"file-type" + newline gated by .newlines). macho.dump L360 (banner `{s}: Mach-O 64-bit object`). wasm.dump L370 (banner `{s}: WebAssembly binary`). macho/wasm banners are placeholders-but-non-TODO; FEAT-002+ replace bodies with real parsing.
- usage string: --all-headers alias line extended with --program-headers --dynamic; new usage lines added for --dynamic-relocs, --program-headers/--segments, --dynamic, --dynamic-symbols, --summary, -d/--disassemble (with honesty note 'sBPF only; other machines print disassembly not implemented for <machine>'), --disassemble-all, --disassemble=[symbol].

FINAL Options field names/order for later FEATs: file_headers, section_headers, relocs, symbols, strings, tls (existing) then program_headers, dynamic, dynamic_relocs, dynamic_symbols, summary, disassemble, disassemble_all, disassemble_symbol(?[]const u8). NOTE: elf.dump uses `std.elf.Header.read(r)` which drops e_flags; FEAT-002 (per design §4.1) must switch to the raw takeStruct(Elf64.Ehdr)/Header.init path to capture e_flags for the summary/sbpf-version work.
